canonical_project: AdaniConneX Hyderabad data centre campus (Chandanvelly / Pargi Road)
notes: AdaniConneX announced (at WEF Davos) a ~US$600 million, 100 MW data centre campus at Chandanvelly, Telangana (listed at Pargi Road, Elkatta, Rangareddy district); construction was progressing per 2023 reports; facility reportedly rated 5-star green building.
